review.fillup_reason: Single targeted regeneration: simplify clutter, brighten dark blades, separate repeated plate-and-tool compositions. Four original 4x contacts inspected before planning this retry.
review.verdict: All five sheet contacts inspected at exactly 4x. All eight initially failed subjects received one targeted retry. Fifteen retries and two planned alternates selected. Original read_the_line retained to avoid the retry resembling catch_blade. Weak: thresher_arc has a dark motion crescent; read_the_line caliper tool is abstract; hairline_mark chisel remains thin. No selected subject visibly bleeds into a gutter; final motifs are distinct. Sheet 3 and 4 use equal horizontal division because full-length global magenta runs are absent; inspected per-cell boundaries are intact.
